verdict.rationale: Railway's site states that every pull request gets its own preview, and it advertises instant previews, unlimited environments and public endpoints live from the moment you deploy. Together these clearly cover the core story of automatic per-PR previews. The evidence is only marketing-level, though, and that a public URL is generated for each preview is implied rather than spelled out. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of PR environment and preview URL behavior (setup, URL format, teardown on merge/close), independent or hands-on corroboration.
